subject: Chemistry
basis: PRIMARY SOURCE: the chapter-level NDA column of Subjects/Chem/NDA_SB_Syllabus.docx,
which already maps all 32 State Board chapters to NDA / CET. That mapping is used as
written; it is the teaching call already made in-house.
(NDA_Syllabus.pdf is a scan with no text layer, so the docx is the usable source.)
Cross-checked against 261 NDA Chemistry PYQs (2017-2026). The NDA bank uses its own
Class 9-10-style taxonomy - Carbon and Its Compounds, Atomic Structure and Periodic
Classification, Acids/Bases/Salts, Chemical Reactions, Matter and Its States, Industrial
and Applied Chemistry - so chapters are compared by CONTENT, not by name.

Bank validation found 7 NDA separation-technique PYQs (2017-2023) - separating kerosene from petrol, refining petroleum, sublimation of sulphur vapour and of anthracene, separating two miscible liquids. They sit under 'Matter and Its States' in the NDA taxonomy, which is why a chapter-name check missed them. Distillation, fractional distillation, sublimation and solvent extraction are asked; chromatography is not.

The bank holds 11 NDA bonding PYQs (2019-2025), but they are elementary - valency, oxidation state, identifying a covalent compound, coordination number in the NaCl lattice, melting point of oxides. That matches NDA's 'elementary ideas... valency' scope. Teach the ionic/covalent/valency foundations; VSEPR, VBT, MOT, hybridization and resonance are well beyond NDA.
